name: Create a cover pattern with repeated display text over image
query: Create a full-width cover pattern for a jazz collection with a background image and one short word repeated four times in gradually darker display colors.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-patterns and confirm image asset, repeated word, text domain, metadata, and color presets
Step 2: Use a Cover block with image, focal point, and dim or duotone treatment
Step 3: Repeat only a short readable word or phrase, not long content
Step 4: Use varied display colors or preset tones to create depth while preserving contrast
Step 5: Keep the repeated text meaningful as a poster-like visual device
Step 6: Escape and translate visible strings
Step 7: Verify readability, mobile fit, and editor parsing
success_criteria: Uses Cover with image and intentional overlay/focal treatment
Repeats a short display word in varied tones
Does not repeat long paragraphs or create unreadable clutter
Uses block-native typography and color choices
All visible strings are escaped and internationalized
No scripts, inline style tags, custom CSS classes, or runtime PHP
Verification includes mobile overflow and readability
